sources.sentence: We saved one tank of fuel; we must not burn through it in a day.

brief.meaningEn: Use a supply of money, time, fuel or another resource very quickly, often faster than is sensible.
brief.meaningZh: 很快耗用金錢、時間、燃料等資源，往往快得不合宜。
brief.grammar: burn through + resource; burn through it/the supply, not burn it through for this depletion sense. Burned or burnt may be used as the past form; examples here use burned.
brief.register: Informal resource-use phrasal verb. Rapid depletion may be figurative, but fuel can also literally burn; explain the rate of use and the resource, rather than infer physical fire in every example.
brief.boundaryZh: 耗用快不等於資源必已用盡，也不一定是故意浪費；需看速度及原定用途。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要只憑支出總額判浪費，也不把保存資源等同完全不使用。
brief.outcomeZh: 能把使用速度連到有限資源及後續用途，提出有根據的調整。

listening.promptZh: 時間怎樣被耗用，後來有甚麼調整？

options.en: Repeated opening rehearsals used much of the session, so the group planned section timings for next time.
options.zh: 反覆排開場用了大半時段，所以小組計劃下次逐段計時。

options.en: The group rehearsed the whole programme evenly and left the final ten minutes for a discussion.
options.zh: 小組平均排了整個節目，留最後十分鐘討論。

options.en: The rehearsal had not begun because the group was still waiting for a room.
options.zh: 排練尚未開始，小組仍在等房間。

options.en: The ending took most of the session, so the group decided to omit the opening next week.
options.zh: 結尾用了大半時段，所以小組決定下周省掉開場。

listening.explanationZh: 時間主要花在反覆開場，結尾仍未試；調整是下次逐段計時，不是已平均試完或結尾佔時最多。
listening.en: We burned through the rehearsal time by repeating the opening scene before checking the rest of the programme; with ten minutes left, we had not tried the ending, so we agreed to time each section next week.
listening.zh: 我們未先試其餘節目便反覆排開場，很快耗去排練時間；剩十分鐘時仍未試結尾，所以約定下周逐段計時。

reply.promptEn: Why did you decide to time the sections next week?
reply.promptZh: 你們為甚麼決定下周逐段計時？

options.en: Repeating the opening left too little time to try the ending.
options.zh: 反覆排開場，令結尾可試的時間太少。

options.en: We burned through the rehearsal time on the opening and wanted to leave room for the rest.
options.zh: 我們排開場時很快耗去排練時間，想替其餘部分留時間。

options.en: The session was running out before we had reached the last scene.
options.zh: 尚未排到最後一幕，時段已快完。

options.en: A clearer division of the session would help us practise more than the first scene.
options.zh: 把時段分得更清楚，可幫我們不只練第一幕。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均給時間分配及結尾未試的具體理由，不把排練等同沒有開始或所有時間已歸零。

scene.promptZh: 虛構攝製隊只有一組充好電的備用電池，卻長時間用來反覆試燈；現在仍有電，但拍正式訪問前需重整試燈方法。哪句準確？

options.en: They are burning through the spare battery supply during lighting tests and need to protect enough power for the interview.
options.zh: 他們試燈時正很快耗用備用電池電量，需替訪問保留足夠電力。

options.en: The spare battery has remained unused because the lighting tests were done without it.
options.zh: 試燈時沒有使用備用電池，所以它一直未用。

options.en: The account confirms that the interview has already been filmed before any lighting tests.
options.zh: 敘述確認訪問已在試燈前拍好。

scene.explanationZh: 反覆試燈正在耗電，正式訪問仍待拍；不必等完全沒電，才可以描述耗用很快。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 burn through a resource 推出？

options.en: The resource is being used rapidly.
options.zh: 資源正被快速使用。

options.en: The entire supply has definitely reached zero.
options.zh: 全部供應肯定已用盡。

options.en: The context may raise a concern about how long the supply will last.
options.zh: 情境可能關注供應能維持多久。

contrast.explanationZh: 快速耗用描述速度，並不自動表示已全部用光。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說只要排練室還有十分鐘，就不用改反覆排開場的做法；但結尾仍未試。哪句最好？

options.en: We have some time left, but we burned through most of it on one scene; let us give the ending a slot and time the sections next week.
options.zh: 我們仍有一點時間，但已在一幕很快耗去大半；先給結尾一段時間，下周再逐段計時吧。

options.en: Let us repeat the opening again and decide about the ending only after the room booking finishes.
options.zh: 再排一次開場，等房間預約時段完結才決定結尾怎辦吧。

options.en: Since the opening has been rehearsed repeatedly, the ending probably needs no separate trial.
options.zh: 開場已反覆排，所以結尾大概不用另試。

dialogue.explanationZh: 剩少量時間仍需看未做部分；反覆開場不代表結尾已熟，也不應等時段完才分配。

speaking.en: We burned through the available time on small revisions, so we need to choose what must be finished before adding more changes.
speaking.zh: 我們在小修訂上很快耗去可用時間，所以再加改動前，需先選出必須完成的事。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再說明耗用速度與尚待完成的工作。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你在虛構桌上遊戲中帶隊穿越沙漠，每隊有十枚水量代幣。你們首段不斷取近路，已花七枚，尚未到補給點。你想在遊戲日誌承認消耗快，提議先查剩下路段的用量再選路，不把遊戲規則當真實求生建議。用一至兩句英文記錄。

examples.en: We burned through our water tokens on the shortcuts and have only three left before the supply point. Let us check the cost of the remaining routes before choosing the next move.
examples.zh: 我們走近路時很快耗用水量代幣，到補給點前只剩三枚；下一步選路前，先查餘下路段的用量吧。

examples.en: We are burning through the water tokens faster than we expected in this game. Before spending another one, we should compare the routes that still lead to the supply point.
examples.zh: 這場遊戲中，水量代幣消耗比預期快；再花一枚前，應比較仍可通往補給點的路線。

writing.selfCheckZh: 以遊戲代幣及剩餘路段說消耗速度，先核規則所列用量；不說資源已歸零，也不把遊戲安排當真實求生規則。

takeaways.en: The printer burned through our paper supply while producing duplicate copies, so we stopped the repeated job.
takeaways.zh: 打印機不斷印重複副本，很快耗用紙張存量，所以我們停止重複工作。

takeaways.en: We were burning through the travel fund on extra taxi journeys and decided to review the remaining visits.
takeaways.zh: 我們額外坐的士，很快耗用旅費，所以決定重看餘下到訪安排。

sources.sentence: The next committee may have to clean up a mess.

brief.meaningEn: Deal with and repair problems caused by earlier actions or decisions.
brief.meaningZh: 處理及修復先前行動或決定造成的問題。
brief.grammar: clean up a/the mess; clean it up is also possible when it has a clear antecedent. In this lesson mess refers to disorganised or damaging consequences, not physical dirt.
brief.register: Conventional cleaning metaphor, often critical. Describe the actual problem and repair without assigning blame beyond the evidence.
brief.boundaryZh: 收拾問題不證已全部解決，也不自動表示負責修復的人造成問題。
brief.misconceptionZh: 可追查原因及改流程，同時處理眼前影響；不是一律把責任推給新接手的人。
brief.outcomeZh: 能分清問題的形成、承受影響及後續修復。

listening.promptZh: 新團隊處理甚麼問題？

options.en: They resolved overlapping wall promises by checking the messages and finding separate spaces.
options.zh: 他們核訊息並安排不同空間，處理重複承諾牆面的問題。

options.en: They created a new booking list before any artist had been offered a wall.
options.zh: 尚未向藝術家提供牆面前，他們先建立新預約名單。

options.en: They cleaned paint from the wall while leaving both bookings unchanged.
options.zh: 他們清掉牆上油漆，仍保留兩項原預約。

options.en: They cancelled the exhibition rather than compare the earlier messages.
options.zh: 他們取消展覽，沒有比較先前訊息。

listening.explanationZh: mess 是重複承諾的後果；核訊息及另配空間是修復，不是清油漆或未有問題時建名單。
listening.en: The new exhibition team had to clean up a mess left by conflicting booking lists: two artists had been promised the same wall, so the team checked the messages and arranged separate spaces before opening.
listening.zh: 新展覽團隊需收拾互相矛盾的預約名單留下的問題：兩位藝術家都獲承諾同一面牆，所以團隊核訊息，開幕前另作空間安排。

reply.promptEn: Why did the new exhibition team have extra work before opening?
reply.promptZh: 新展覽團隊為甚麼在開幕前多了工作？

options.en: Two artists had been offered the same wall in conflicting lists.
options.zh: 互相矛盾的名單把同一面牆提供給兩位藝術家。

options.en: They had to clean up a mess caused by overlapping booking promises.
options.zh: 他們需收拾重複預約承諾造成的問題。

options.en: They needed to check earlier messages before rearranging the spaces.
options.zh: 他們需先核對先前訊息，再重新分配空間。

options.en: The earlier arrangements left a conflict that had to be resolved before the exhibition opened.
options.zh: 先前安排留下衝突，需在展覽開幕前解決。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均指出先前預約造成的新工作，沒有把接手修復的人當成原因。

scene.promptZh: 學生刊物更正兩個互換的照片說明後，有讀者仍在轉發舊版；編輯正聯絡轉發者並發清楚更正，未說已全修復。哪句貼切？

options.en: The editors are cleaning up the mess from the swapped captions, including the copies already being shared.
options.zh: 編輯正收拾照片說明互換造成的問題，包括已被轉發的副本。

options.en: The editors are cleaning the camera equipment before writing any captions.
options.zh: 編輯在寫照片說明前，正清潔相機器材。

options.en: The corrected captions show that the old shared copies no longer need attention.
options.zh: 照片說明已更正，表示不用再理會被轉發的舊副本。

scene.explanationZh: 修復不只改原檔，也處理已流通版本的影響；這裏不是清潔器材，亦未證舊版影響已消失。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 someone is cleaning up a mess 的問題修復意思推出？

options.en: They are dealing with consequences that need putting right.
options.zh: 他們正處理需要修正的後果。

options.en: They must have caused the original problem themselves.
options.zh: 原來問題必定是他們自己造成。

options.en: The context should explain what went wrong and what repair is being attempted.
options.zh: 情境應說明哪裏出錯，以及正嘗試甚麼修復。

contrast.explanationZh: 執行修復的人可能是新接手者，不能只憑這說法歸責。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說新團隊既在收拾預約問題，便應把重複承諾寫成他們作出的；訊息卻來自前一輪安排。哪句最好？

options.en: They are cleaning up the mess, but the earlier messages show when the overlapping promises were made; let us keep responsibility and repair separate.
options.zh: 他們正收拾問題，但先前訊息顯示重複承諾何時作出；把形成責任與修復工作分清吧。

options.en: Then the current team must have made both promises if they are the ones sorting them out.
options.zh: 既然現時團隊在處理兩項承諾，那兩項承諾一定是他們作出的。

options.en: Since the promises were made earlier, the new team can leave both artists assigned to the same wall.
options.zh: 承諾既在先前作出，新團隊就可讓兩位藝術家仍用同一面牆。

dialogue.explanationZh: 根據訊息分清時間與責任，同時仍需修復眼前衝突；不是因接手便歸責，也不是因非自己造成便不處理。

speaking.en: The volunteers are cleaning up the mess from the cancelled orders, but we still need to understand why the notices were sent so late.
speaking.zh: 義工正收拾取消訂單留下的問題，但我們仍需了解通知為何這麼遲才發出。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清眼前修復與查明原因。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你寫一段小說，角色曾向兩位朋友轉述未核實的指控，後來發現是自己把兩件事混在一起。他要在對話承認造成問題，向同樣兩人澄清已知事實，並在未查清部分保留未知，不要求被誤會的人先安慰他。用一至兩句英文寫他的話。

examples.en: I made the accusation before checking it, and I need to clean up the mess by correcting what I told both of you. I mixed up two events, and I should not present the part I still do not know as a fact.
examples.zh: 我未查證便作指控，需向你們兩人更正我所說的話，收拾造成的問題；我把兩件事混在一起，不應把仍未知的部分當事實。

examples.en: I need to clean up this mess because my unverified story gave you a false impression of her. Let me tell both of you what I have confirmed and what remains uncertain.
examples.zh: 我需收拾這個問題，因未查證的說法讓你們誤會她；讓我向你們兩人說清已確認甚麼，以及仍有甚麼未知。

writing.selfCheckZh: 角色承認自己的未核實轉述及混淆，向原來兩位聽者澄清；分清已知未知，不把道歉當影響已全消失或要求受影響者先安慰自己。

takeaways.en: The incoming treasurer had to clean up a mess of duplicate invoices before the club could review its spending.
takeaways.zh: 新接手的司庫需先收拾重複發票的問題，社團才能檢視支出。

takeaways.en: I am cleaning up the mess from my unclear instructions by contacting the people who received the wrong version.
takeaways.zh: 我正聯絡收過錯誤版本的人，收拾自己指示不清造成的問題。

brief.meaningEn: Increase in number or amount as more items, demands or small amounts are added over time.
brief.meaningZh: 隨更多項目、要求或小量事物加入，數量或總量逐漸增加。
brief.grammar: costs/messages/work pile up; piled/piling up. This intransitive accumulation use differs from pile something up in a physical heap; no visible stack is necessary.
brief.register: Common phrasal verb for accumulation. It does not by itself give an exact total or explain whether all accumulated items are urgent.
brief.boundaryZh: 累積不等於每項都重要或總量已核實；要分加入速度、已處理部分及仍餘項目。
brief.misconceptionZh: 一次很多與逐漸累積可不同；也不能因每次少就忽略合計影響。
brief.outcomeZh: 能辨認累積過程，用紀錄或分類了解總量及下一步。

listening.promptZh: 問題怎樣累積，團隊先做甚麼？

options.en: Several helpers added questions over time, and the team grouped repeated issues before replying.
options.zh: 幾位幫手陸續加入問題，團隊先合併重複事項，再回覆。

options.en: One final message settled the room change before the inbox received any questions.
options.zh: 收件箱收到問題前，一封最後訊息已解決房間更改。

options.en: The helpers waited until the organiser returned before forwarding any questions.
options.zh: 幫手等負責人回來，才轉發任何問題。

options.en: The organiser had already answered the forwarded questions while away.
options.zh: 負責人不在期間，已答好被轉發的問題。

listening.explanationZh: 每位幫手陸續轉幾封形成累積，部分問題重複；團隊先分組再派回覆，不是等負責人回來才轉發，也不是已答完或一封訊息已解決。
listening.en: Questions piled up in the shared inbox while the organiser was away: each helper forwarded a few more, and several concerned the same room change, so we grouped duplicates before assigning replies.
listening.zh: 負責人不在時，問題在共用收件箱逐漸累積；每位幫手都再轉來幾封，有幾封關於同一房間更改，所以我們先合併重複項目，再分配回覆。

reply.promptEn: Why did you group the inbox questions before assigning replies?
reply.promptZh: 你們為甚麼先整理收件箱問題，再分配回覆？

options.en: Several messages concerned the same room change.
options.zh: 幾封訊息都關於同一房間更改。

options.en: Questions had piled up, and grouping duplicates would stop us treating each copy as a separate issue.
options.zh: 問題已逐漸累積，合併重複項目可避免把每個副本當成不同事項。

options.en: The number of forwarded messages did not tell us how many different problems needed an answer.
options.zh: 被轉發訊息的數量，未能直接說明有多少不同問題需回答。

options.en: We needed to see the repeated topics before dividing the work among helpers.
options.zh: 分工前，我們需先看出重複主題。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均以重複內容及分工需求解釋整理，不只把訊息數等同不同問題數。

scene.promptZh: 虛構社團每次活動只添一兩項小收費，季度結算時才發現合計比預留款多；各項已列日期，但尚未重算總數。哪句準確？

options.en: The small charges have piled up, so the club needs to check the recorded total rather than judge each fee alone.
options.zh: 小額收費已逐漸累積，所以社團需核紀錄總額，不能只看每項收費。

options.en: Only one charge was recorded, and it replaced all the earlier activity costs.
options.zh: 只記了一項收費，它取代先前活動費用。

options.en: The current records already confirm the exact total and leave no calculation to check.
options.zh: 現有紀錄已確認確切總額，沒有計算需核。

scene.explanationZh: 多次小額合成較大總量，仍需重算；不是只一次或總數已核妥。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 work has piled up 推出？

options.en: More work has accumulated over a period.
options.zh: 一段時間內，工作逐漸增加。

options.en: Every accumulated task has the same urgency.
options.zh: 每項累積工作都有相同緊急程度。

options.en: The current total may reflect many small additions.
options.zh: 現有總量可能來自許多小量加入。

contrast.explanationZh: 累積描述數量變化，不替每項工作判相同優先程度。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友想把收件箱每個副本都分給不同人答，理由是訊息多就必定是不同問題；你見到多封問同一房間更改。哪句最好？

options.en: The messages have piled up, but some repeat one issue; let us group them before deciding who replies.
options.zh: 訊息已累積，但部分重複同一問題；決定誰回覆前，先把它們分組吧。

options.en: Let us assign each forwarded copy separately and compare the topics only after the replies are sent.
options.zh: 先把每個轉發副本分開派出，寄回覆後才比較主題吧。

options.en: Since some messages repeat a topic, we can close the inbox without checking the other questions.
options.zh: 既然部分訊息重複主題，就不用看其他問題，可以結束收件處理。

dialogue.explanationZh: 分組可減重複回覆，但仍需看不同問題；不是每副本各答，也不是見有重複便不看其餘。

speaking.en: Small requests can pile up during a busy week, so I want to sort the repeated ones before agreeing to another deadline.
speaking.zh: 忙碌一周中，小請求可逐漸累積，所以再答應期限前，我想先整理重複項目。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清累積數量與實際不同任務。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你在小說寫角色逐漸不滿：室友連續幾周借走文具不放回、把修理工作留給他，他每次都沒說。今次他想說明小怨氣已累積，邀對方一起選一條歸還及分工規則，不把一次漏放說成所有關係都壞。用一至兩句英文寫他的話。

examples.en: My frustrations have piled up because I kept finding the stationery missing and the repairs left to me. Can we agree where borrowed things go back and how to share the next repair?
examples.zh: 我不斷發現文具不在，又要獨自處理修理，怨氣已逐漸累積；我們可否議定借物放回哪裏，以及下次怎分擔修理？

examples.en: The small annoyances have been piling up, and staying silent has not helped us sort them out. I would like us to agree on returning the stationery and dividing the repair work.
examples.zh: 小煩惱一直累積，保持沉默未幫我們處理；我想一起議定歸還文具及分配修理工作。

writing.selfCheckZh: 指出數周累積及之前未說，提出具體歸還與分工安排；不把一次不便當整段關係定論，也不聲稱對方動機已知。

takeaways.en: Little delays piled up during the journey, leaving us less time at the final stop.
takeaways.zh: 旅途中的小延誤逐漸累積，令我們在最後一站剩下較少時間。

takeaways.en: Unanswered requests were piling up while the team waited for one person to approve each response.
takeaways.zh: 團隊等同一人逐一批准回覆期間，未答的請求不斷累積。

brief.meaningEn: Feel personally familiar, relevant or affecting because the topic connects with lived experience; it may be uncomfortable but need not be.
brief.meaningZh: 因話題與自身經驗有關而覺得熟悉、切身或受觸動；可以不自在，但並非必然。
brief.grammar: a comment, story, lyric or issue hits/feels close to home for someone; hit and felt also work in past contexts. Give the personal connection, not merely physical proximity.
brief.register: Emotionally sensitive everyday idiom; a listener may tell a friend why a lyric, story or issue matters personally without disclosing more than they choose.
brief.boundaryZh: 「切身」來自個人經驗或熟悉處境；不必然令人難受，也不等於地點離家很近，更不證明作者刻意針對當事人。
brief.misconceptionZh: 可保留感受及選擇是否透露，不要求當事人公開私事來證明。
brief.outcomeZh: 能以個人經驗解釋觸動，分清感受與他人意圖。

listening.promptZh: 故事為何觸動 Nia，她保留甚麼選擇？

options.en: It connected with a recent friendship change, and she chose not to share private messages.
options.zh: 故事連到她最近的友誼變化，她選擇不分享私人訊息。

options.en: She said the author had copied her private messages into the story.
options.zh: 她說作者把她的私人訊息抄進故事。

options.en: She wanted to avoid the ending because she had never experienced a friend leaving.
options.zh: 她從未經歷朋友離開，所以想避談結局。

options.en: Nia wanted to publish her private messages as part of the discussion.
options.zh: Nia 想把私人訊息公開作討論一部分。

listening.explanationZh: 相似經驗令故事切身，但她仍想談結局，並保留私訊；沒有說作者抄私訊或她想公開私訊。
listening.en: The story about a friend moving away hit close to home for Nia because her own closest friend had just left town; she said she wanted to discuss the ending but not explain her private messages.
listening.zh: 朋友搬走的故事讓 Nia 特別有切身感受，因她最親近的朋友剛離城；她說想談結局，卻不想解釋私人訊息。

reply.promptEn: Why did the story affect Nia so personally?
reply.promptZh: 故事為甚麼對 Nia 有這麼切身的觸動？

options.en: Her closest friend had just moved away, much like the friend in the story.
options.zh: 她最親近的朋友剛搬走，跟故事中的朋友相似。

options.en: It hit close to home because she was dealing with a similar change in her own friendship.
options.zh: 她自己正面對相似的友誼變化，所以故事特別觸動她。

options.en: The departure in the story reminded her of something that had just happened in her life.
options.zh: 故事中的離別讓她想到生活中剛發生的事。

options.en: The theme connected with a recent experience, rather than being only a distant fictional event for her.
options.zh: 主題連到最近的經驗，對她而言不只是一件遙遠的虛構事。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均以朋友剛離開作具體連結，不推作者知私事或刻意針對。

scene.promptZh: 同學聽到講者批評「從不守時的人」，想起自己昨天遲到，覺得尷尬；講者不知道昨天的事。哪句準確？

options.en: The comment hit close to home because she recognised her own recent lateness, not because the speaker knew about it.
options.zh: 她想起自己最近遲到，所以評論讓她感到切身尷尬，不是因講者知道那件事。

options.en: The speaker deliberately described yesterday’s incident after hearing about it from her.
options.zh: 講者聽她說了昨天的事後，刻意描述那件事。

options.en: Her embarrassment came from arriving late for this talk, rather than recalling the previous day.
options.zh: 她因這次講座遲到而尷尬，不是想起前一天。

scene.explanationZh: 本人把評論連到自己的事便可有切身感受，不需講者知情；此處連到昨天的經驗，不是已說這次講座也遲到。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 a story hit close to home 推出？

options.en: Someone found a personal connection with the story.
options.zh: 有人感到故事與自己有切身連結。

options.en: The author deliberately exposed that person’s private history.
options.zh: 作者刻意揭露那人的私人經歷。

options.en: The reaction can be stronger because of an experience outside the story.
options.zh: 故事以外的經驗可令反應更強。

contrast.explanationZh: 切身關連描述讀者反應，不能單憑此推作者知情或故意揭私事。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友想要求 Nia 公開私人訊息，才容她說故事切身；她已說想談結局但保留私訊。哪句最好？

options.en: We can discuss why the ending matters without asking her to show private messages; the story can hit close to home without those details becoming public.
options.zh: 我們可以談結局為何重要，不要求她展示私訊；故事可有切身觸動，不必把細節公開。

options.en: Let us postpone her comments on the ending until she agrees to show the messages.
options.zh: 等她同意展示私訊，才讓她談結局吧。

options.en: If she keeps the messages private, we should describe her response as a general opinion with no personal connection.
options.zh: 若她不公開私訊，就應把回應寫成與本人經驗無關的一般看法。

dialogue.explanationZh: 可尊重她想談的範圍；是否公開私訊不決定本人經驗有沒有切身連結。

speaking.en: The scene hit close to home because it reminded me of a change in my own life, but I would rather keep the details private.
speaking.zh: 場景讓我想到自己生活的變化，所以很有切身觸動，但我寧願保留細節。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再連個人經驗及願意分享的範圍。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你寫給小說編輯的意見，角色聽到一段關於嫉妒的獨白，想起自己曾搶朋友的功勞，先不自在，後來決定私下承認並更正團隊紀錄。你想寫他的轉折，既不說演員知道他往事，也不把不自在當已道歉。用一至兩句英文概述。

examples.en: The monologue hit close to home because he remembered taking credit for his friend’s work. His discomfort led him to admit it privately and ask for the team record to be corrected.
examples.zh: 獨白讓他想起曾搶朋友功勞，所以有切身觸動；不自在促使他私下承認，並要求更正團隊紀錄。

examples.en: The speech about jealousy hit close to home, reminding him of the credit he had taken. He then chose to speak to his friend and correct the record, rather than treat feeling guilty as an apology.
examples.zh: 關於嫉妒的獨白讓他想到搶來的功勞，感到切身觸動；他之後選擇跟朋友談並更正紀錄，不把內疚當成道歉。

writing.selfCheckZh: 以搶功勞的往事連到獨白觸動，再把感受及承認更正兩步分清；不推演員知情，也不以內疚代道歉。

takeaways.en: The discussion of missed promises hit close to home after I realised I had left my sister waiting for a reply.
takeaways.zh: 想到自己曾讓妹妹等回覆後，關於失約的討論對我特別切身。

takeaways.en: The housing debate felt close to home for Mei because her family had recently lost its flat.
takeaways.zh: 美的家人最近失去住所，所以住房辯論令她格外感到切身。

sources.sentence: Water quality goes downhill when waste is ignored.

brief.meaningEn: Become worse in quality, condition or performance over a period.
brief.meaningZh: 質素、狀況或表現隨時間變差。
brief.grammar: something goes/went/has gone/is going downhill; in this lesson downhill is an evaluative change, not a route descending a physical slope.
brief.register: Common informal deterioration image. Identify what became worse and what evidence supports the comparison; it does not make a decline permanent or identify a cause by itself.
brief.boundaryZh: 變差需有前後或趨勢依據，不等於完全失效、必不復原或原因已確定。
brief.misconceptionZh: 一次失誤不必代表持續變差，也不能用一項改善否認另一指標惡化。
brief.outcomeZh: 能以具體指標表達變差，保留原因及後續結果的未知。

listening.promptZh: 哪方面變差，哪方面未變？

options.en: Accuracy worsened across recent issues, while delivery stayed punctual.
options.zh: 最近幾期的準確度變差，發送仍準時。

options.en: The newsletter arrived later each month even though its dates and captions were checked.
options.zh: 通訊每月更遲送到，日期及照片說明卻已核妥。

options.en: The club stopped producing the newsletter before proofreading was reduced.
options.zh: 社團在減少校對前，已停止製作通訊。

options.en: The recent issues corrected earlier errors and contained fewer wrong dates.
options.zh: 最近幾期更正先前錯誤，錯日期減少。

listening.explanationZh: 變差的是準確度，有三期資料；準時仍維持，不是遲送或已停刊。
listening.en: The club’s newsletter went downhill after proofreading was squeezed out of the schedule: the last three issues contained more wrong dates and missing captions, although delivery remained on time.
listening.zh: 社團通訊的校對時間被擠掉後，質素變差；最近三期有更多錯日期及漏照片說明，雖然仍準時發送。

reply.promptEn: Why do you say the newsletter’s quality has fallen?
reply.promptZh: 你為甚麼說通訊質素下降？

options.en: The last three issues had more wrong dates and missing captions.
options.zh: 最近三期有更多錯日期及漏照片說明。

options.en: It went downhill in accuracy after proofreading lost its place in the schedule.
options.zh: 校對時間被擠掉後，它的準確度變差。

options.en: The recent errors show a decline even though the mailing time has not changed.
options.zh: 雖然寄送時間沒變，最近的錯誤仍顯示質素下降。

options.en: Date and caption errors have recurred across several recent issues, despite punctual delivery.
options.zh: 雖然準時發送，最近幾期卻反覆有日期及照片說明錯誤。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均指出多期準確度的變化或比較依據，不把準時當質素全無問題。

scene.promptZh: 虛構遊戲中，小隊沿山坡下行卻連續三回合合作更好、失誤減少；評論者想用 downhill 比喻其表現。哪句最不合資料？

options.en: Their teamwork has gone downhill during these rounds.
options.zh: 這幾回合，他們的團隊合作變差了。

options.en: They are travelling downhill, while their teamwork is improving.
options.zh: 他們正沿坡下行，團隊合作卻在改善。

options.en: A descending route does not show a decline in the team’s performance.
options.zh: 路線下坡，並不表示小隊表現下降。

scene.explanationZh: 身處下坡路線是空間方向，合作改善是表現；不能把字面下坡等同表現變差。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 a service is going downhill 推出？

options.en: Some aspect of its condition or quality is getting worse.
options.zh: 某方面狀況或質素正變差。

options.en: It cannot improve again after the current decline.
options.zh: 這次變差後，它不能再改善。

options.en: The context should show which comparison supports the judgement.
options.zh: 情境應顯示甚麼比較支持這個評價。

contrast.explanationZh: 變差不使未來結果固定；仍需具體指標及後續觀察。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說通訊仍準時寄出，所以日期錯誤多不算質素變差；你有最近三期紀錄。哪句最好？

options.en: Delivery is still punctual, but accuracy has gone downhill; let us restore a date-and-caption check before sending the next issue.
options.zh: 發送仍準時，但準確度已變差；下期寄出前，恢復核對日期及照片說明吧。

options.en: We can use the punctual mailing time as our only quality check and leave the dates unreviewed.
options.zh: 可以只用準時寄送作質素檢查，不再核日期。

options.en: Let us delay the next mailing first, without deciding how its dates and captions will be checked.
options.zh: 先把下次寄送押後，不用先決定怎核日期及照片說明吧。

dialogue.explanationZh: 準時及準確是不同指標；恢復具體核對回應可見問題，不只看時間，也不以延遲本身代校對。

speaking.en: The service has gone downhill in reliability, so I want to compare the recent records before deciding what needs to change.
speaking.zh: 服務的可靠程度已變差，所以決定需改甚麼前，我想比較最近紀錄。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再指出變差的指標及比較依據。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你寫劇本人物的自我反省。他以前每周兩次跟朋友完整談話，近月常邊看手機邊打斷，朋友已說不被留心。他想承認對話質素變差，提議下次先收手機，並請朋友說哪種互動有幫助，不要求一次就原諒。用一至兩句英文寫他的話。

examples.en: Our conversations have gone downhill because I keep interrupting you while checking my phone. Next time I will put it away, and I would like to hear what helps you feel listened to.
examples.zh: 我不斷邊看手機邊打斷你，令我們的對話質素變差；下次我會收起手機，也想聽甚麼讓你感到有人留心。

examples.en: The way I listen has been going downhill, and you have told me how it affects you. I want to keep my phone away during our next conversation and ask whether that changes your experience.
examples.zh: 我的聆聽方式一直變差，你已說明對你的影響；下次談話時，我想把手機放開，再問你的感受有否改變。

writing.selfCheckZh: 承認自己已知的打斷及朋友反應，用具體聆聽安排作下一步，再問實際感受；不把一次改動當修復已完成。

takeaways.en: Attendance went downhill after the timetable changes, but the records did not yet show which change had made the difference.
takeaways.zh: 時間表改動後，出席情況變差，但紀錄尚未顯示哪項改動造成影響。

takeaways.en: The recording quality was going downhill as the microphone connection loosened, so we stopped to check the cable.
takeaways.zh: 咪高峰接駁鬆脫時，錄音質素逐漸變差，所以我們停下來查接線。

sources.sentence: The river is polluted, but it is not a lost cause.

brief.meaningEn: An effort, situation or problem considered unlikely or impossible to improve or succeed.
brief.meaningZh: 被認為很難或不可能改善或成功的努力、情況或問題。
brief.grammar: call/consider something a lost cause; not a lost cause rejects that judgement. Explain whose judgement it is and what evidence supports or challenges it.
brief.register: Established idiom expressing an evaluation, often pessimistic. A difficulty is not automatically hopeless; avoid applying it as a degrading label to a person.
brief.boundaryZh: 判無望是評價，不是見困難便可當事實；否定它也不等於保證成功。
brief.misconceptionZh: 可承認損害及未知，同時保留有依據的改善途徑，不把希望變承諾。
brief.outcomeZh: 能分清困難、判斷及可檢驗的改善線索。

listening.promptZh: 甚麼支持「並非無望」，還有甚麼限制？

options.en: Some speech was recovered, while the unclear middle still had to be distinguished from guesses.
options.zh: 部分說話已恢復，仍需把不清楚中段與推測分開。

options.en: The archivist confirmed that the complete recording was clear before any work began.
options.zh: 工作開始前，檔案員已確認整段錄音清楚。

options.en: No speech could be recovered, so the team replaced the introduction with invented words.
options.zh: 沒有說話能恢復，所以團隊用自創字句取代介紹。

options.en: The unclear middle was omitted because the speaker had deliberately recorded silence.
options.zh: 講者刻意錄下沉默，所以不清楚的中段被省掉。

listening.explanationZh: 已恢復介紹是改善線索，中段仍未知；不是全清楚，也沒有支持自創字句或刻意沉默。
listening.en: The damaged recording was not a lost cause: the archivist could recover the speaker’s introduction, though the middle section remained unclear, so we kept the recovered words separate from our guesses.
listening.zh: 受損錄音並非無望修復；檔案員能恢復講者的介紹，但中段仍不清楚，所以我們把恢復的字句與推測分開。

reply.promptEn: Why did you decide to keep working on the damaged recording?
reply.promptZh: 你們為甚麼決定繼續處理受損錄音？

options.en: The archivist had already recovered a useful introduction.
options.zh: 檔案員已恢復有用的介紹。

options.en: It was not a lost cause because part of the speech could be recovered.
options.zh: 部分說話能恢復，所以並非無望修復。

options.en: The remaining difficulty did not erase the progress we had made.
options.zh: 仍有困難，不會抹掉已有的進展。

options.en: We could preserve the words we could actually hear without claiming that the whole recording was clear.
options.zh: 我們可保存實際聽得出的字句，不必聲稱整段錄音都清楚。

reply.explanationZh: 四句給已有進展及有用部分作理由，不以部分恢復保證全部成功。

scene.promptZh: 社團花園部分植物枯死，但本周新栽的一區已發芽，義工仍在記錄不同區域；有人說整個修復無望。哪句最有依據？

options.en: The garden is not a lost cause, given the new growth, though the other areas still need assessment.
options.zh: 新生長支持花園並非無望修復，但其他區域仍需評估。

options.en: The new growth was already present in every area before the restoration began.
options.zh: 修復開始前，每個區域已出現新生長。

options.en: The remaining areas have already been assessed and found to be responding in the same way.
options.zh: 餘下區域已評估，發現反應相同。

scene.explanationZh: 本周新栽一區發芽，可反對全無改善希望；未說修復前各區已有新生長，也未完成其他區域評估。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 someone calls a project a lost cause 推出？

options.en: That person thinks the project is unlikely to succeed or improve.
options.zh: 那人認為項目很難成功或改善。

options.en: The judgement has been independently proved just by being expressed.
options.zh: 只要這個判斷被說出口，便已獲獨立證實。

options.en: Other evidence might challenge the pessimistic judgement.
options.zh: 其他證據可能挑戰這個悲觀判斷。

contrast.explanationZh: 這是判斷，仍需看證據；不能因有人這樣說便當證實。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴想因中段不清，就把受損錄音全部丟掉；介紹已恢復，也有保存條件。哪句最好？

options.en: It is not a lost cause; let us preserve the recovered introduction and label the unclear section rather than invent or discard it.
options.zh: 它並非無望；保存已恢復的介紹，標明不清楚部分，不自創或把整段丟掉吧。

options.en: Let us write a likely middle section and present it in the same way as the recovered speech.
options.zh: 寫一段似乎可能的中段，把它當作跟已恢復說話一樣呈現吧。

options.en: The introduction is clear, so we can stop marking which words in the middle remain uncertain.
options.zh: 介紹清楚，所以不用再標中段哪些字仍未知。

dialogue.explanationZh: 有用進展可保存，未知仍需標；不以希望代證據，也不把部分清楚當整段可確認。

speaking.en: The project is not a lost cause, but we need to test the proposed repair before promising what can be recovered.
speaking.zh: 項目並非無望，但承諾能恢復甚麼前，我們需先試建議的修復方法。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再把改善可能與確定結果分開。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你在學校寫作社主持故事構思討論。一位作者因偵探結尾的時間線有矛盾，想刪整篇；你已發現只要把一次約會由星期二改到星期三，重要線索仍可連上，但作者仍需重讀查其他影響。用一至兩句英文給他具體建議，不把作品或作者貶成無用。

examples.en: The story is not a lost cause: moving that meeting to Wednesday would let the clue fit the timeline. Try that change and reread the earlier scenes before deciding what else needs revision.
examples.zh: 故事並非無望；把那次見面移到星期三，可讓線索配合時間線；先試這改動，再重讀較早場景，之後才決定還需改甚麼。

examples.en: I would not call this a lost cause when one change could resolve the timing conflict. Could you move the meeting to Wednesday and check how that affects the other clues?
examples.zh: 一項改動可能解決時間衝突，我不會說它無望；可否把見面移到星期三，再查對其他線索有何影響？

writing.selfCheckZh: 指出已發現的可試改動及需重讀範圍，不以一句鼓勵代實際途徑，也不把可能可修當已消除所有矛盾。

takeaways.en: The neglected garden was not a lost cause, as the first restored beds were beginning to grow again.
takeaways.zh: 荒置花園並非無望，首批修復花床已開始再生長。

takeaways.en: He called the appeal a lost cause before reading the new evidence, so the group asked him to reconsider.
takeaways.zh: 他未讀新證據便說申訴無望，所以小組請他再考慮。

chinese.evidence: Traditional Chinese checked against English subjects, negation, tense and modality; no independent human approval claimed.

lessons.titleEn: off the top of my head
lessons.titleZh: 未準備或核對便憑記憶說

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Off the top of my head, I can name three examples.
sources.expression: off the top of my head

brief.meaningEn: From immediate memory, without checking information or preparing an answer first.
brief.meaningZh: 未先核對資料或準備答案，直接憑當下記憶說出。
brief.grammar: off the top of my head + recalled answer/estimate; change the possessive to match the speaker. It signals the manner of recall, not automatically an inaccurate answer.
brief.register: Informal spoken qualification. It is useful for provisional recall, but important details may still need verification before use.
brief.boundaryZh: 未核不等於必錯，亦不等於可信度已足以刊用；需說清哪些部分待核。
brief.misconceptionZh: 可先給大概或例子，再查資料；不要把記憶中的數字寫成已查證總數。
brief.outcomeZh: 能在即時回答中標示記憶來源，安排合適核對。

listening.promptZh: 哪項是即時記憶，哪項仍待查？

options.en: Two examples are recalled, while the full participation count needs the attendance list.
options.zh: 先憑記憶想起兩個例子，完整參與數仍需核出席名單。

options.en: The speaker has checked the list and confirmed that exactly two schools attended.
options.zh: 說話者已核名單，確認恰好兩間學校參加。

options.en: The speaker cannot recall any school and is reading the names from the invitation.
options.zh: 說話者想不起任何學校，正從邀請讀校名。

options.en: The invitation has already been printed with the verified attendance total.
options.zh: 邀請已按查證過的出席總數刊印。

listening.explanationZh: 兩間是當下想起的例子，不是已核總數；刊印前仍需查出席名單。
listening.en: Off the top of my head, I can remember two schools that joined last year, but I do not have the attendance list here; I will check it before we print the invitation’s claim about how many took part.
listening.zh: 憑當下記憶，我想起去年參加的兩間學校，但手邊沒有出席名單；邀請刊印參與校數前，我會先核名單。

reply.promptEn: Why do you want to check the attendance list before printing?
reply.promptZh: 刊印前你為甚麼想核出席名單？

options.en: I remember examples but have not verified the full number of schools.
options.zh: 我記得例子，但未核完整校數。

options.en: I named two schools off the top of my head, not from a checked total.
options.zh: 我憑當下記憶說出兩間學校，不是按已核總數。

options.en: The invitation needs a participation count, and my first answer was only immediate recall.
options.zh: 邀請需有參與數，我首次回答只是即時記憶。

options.en: Other schools may be on the list even though those were the first two I remembered.
options.zh: 名單可能還有其他學校，雖然我最先想起那兩間。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均分例子記憶與完整總數；未核不表示所想起的兩校一定錯。

scene.promptZh: 朋友問你附近哪裏可安靜寫作，你未看最新開門時間，先想起圖書館及公園亭；你願提醒他出門前確認。哪句最合適？

options.en: Off the top of my head, the library and the park pavilion come to mind, but check whether they are open before going.
options.zh: 憑當下記憶，我想到圖書館及公園亭，但去前先查是否開放。

options.en: I have just checked today’s opening times and confirmed that both places are available now.
options.zh: 我剛核今天開放時間，確認兩處現時都可用。

options.en: The first two places I remember are the only quiet writing spaces in the area.
options.zh: 我最先記起的兩處，就是區內僅有的安靜寫作空間。

scene.explanationZh: 可先給記得的選項，清楚保留開放資料待查；不是已查現況或列盡所有地方。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 I answered off the top of my head 推出？

options.en: The answer was given without prior checking or preparation.
options.zh: 答案未先核對或準備便說出。

options.en: The answer must be factually wrong.
options.zh: 答案事實上必定錯誤。

options.en: The speaker relied on what came to mind immediately.
options.zh: 說話者依靠當下想起的內容。

contrast.explanationZh: 說法描述回答方式，不直接判定內容真假。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴想把你剛憑記憶舉的兩間學校當去年總數；你已說名單不在手邊。哪句最好？

options.en: Those were examples off the top of my head, so let us check the list before using two as the total.
options.zh: 那些只是我當下記起的例子；把兩間當總數前，先核名單吧。

options.en: Let us use two as the confirmed total now and compare it with the list only after printing.
options.zh: 現在先用兩間作已確認總數，印後才跟名單比較吧。

options.en: Because I did not check the list, we should remove even the two examples before asking whether they attended.
options.zh: 我未核名單，所以先刪掉那兩個例子，不用再問是否參加吧。

dialogue.explanationZh: 例子需核而非直接升格總數；也不必把未核當必錯，應先查資料。

speaking.en: Off the top of my head, I can suggest a few examples, but I would check the records before giving a complete list.
speaking.zh: 憑當下記憶，我可先提幾個例子，但給完整名單前，我會先核紀錄。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清即時想起的例子與查證後的完整資料。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你在小說讀書會被問哪個配角最早發現失物。你一時記得園丁在第二章提過鑰匙，卻不確定第一章的送信人有沒有先看到；你想先說記憶中的判斷，再邀一起翻章節，不把它當比賽搶答。用一至兩句英文回應。

examples.en: Off the top of my head, I would say the gardener because I remember the key in chapter two. Could we check the messenger’s scene in chapter one before deciding who noticed it first?
examples.zh: 憑當下記憶，我會說是園丁，因我記得第二章的鑰匙；決定誰先發現前，可否查第一章送信人的場景？

examples.en: I think it was the gardener, but that is off the top of my head rather than a checked sequence. Let us compare those two chapters and see whether the messenger noticed the key earlier.
examples.zh: 我想是園丁，但只是憑當下記憶，不是核過的次序；比較兩章，看看送信人是否更早發現鑰匙吧。

writing.selfCheckZh: 把首次猜測連到記得的章節，再查另一場景以判先後；不由記憶自信當已查證，也不把未核說成必錯。

takeaways.en: Off the top of my head, I remember three designs, though the catalogue may contain others.
takeaways.zh: 憑當下記憶，我記得三款設計，但目錄可能還有其他。

takeaways.en: She answered off the top of her head, then checked the programme before sending the starting time to visitors.
takeaways.zh: 她先憑當下記憶回答，再核節目表，之後才把開始時間發給訪客。

review.author: AI author source_inventory

english.evidence: Immediate recall marker, not certainty or automatic falsity. Final asks to establish narrative chronology from two chapters, distinct from complete school counts and current opening-time verification.

chinese.evidence: Traditional Chinese checked against English subjects, negation, tense and modality; no independent human approval claimed.

lessons.titleZh: 屬最受重視或表現突出之列

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: For commuters, air quality is right up there with travel time.

brief.meaningEn: Among the most important, impressive or highly regarded examples in the stated comparison.
brief.meaningZh: 在所作比較中，屬最重要、出色或受重視的一群。
brief.grammar: be right up there with + comparison; right up there among + group; give the quality or ranking criterion. The phrase is informal and need not state an exact numerical rank.
brief.register: Informal evaluative ranking phrase. It can concern priorities or quality; it is not evidence that all judges agree or a literal high location.
brief.boundaryZh: 居重要或優秀之列不等於獨一第一，也不代表其他標準都高；應說是誰評甚麼。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把個人排序當正式比賽結果，也不由重要程度直接判已做到最好。
brief.outcomeZh: 能限定比較範圍及評價指標，避免把高評價寫成確切名次。

listening.promptZh: 通道及費用在比較中處於甚麼位置？

options.en: They were major priorities considered before the lighting, while the venue choice remained open.
options.zh: 它們是比燈光先考慮的主要事項，場地仍未選定。

options.en: Cost had already been dropped from the comparison because lighting was the only priority.
options.zh: 費用已從比較中刪去，因燈光是唯一考慮。

options.en: They ranked lighting above access and left the cost comparison until later.
options.zh: 他們把燈光排在通道之前，費用比較留到之後。

options.en: A hall had already been booked before access and cost were compared.
options.zh: 比較通道及費用前，禮堂已預約好。

listening.explanationZh: right up there 表示重要程度；通道及費用均先考慮，場地仍未決定。
listening.en: For the volunteers choosing a rehearsal venue, step-free access was right up there with cost: they compared both before considering the stage lights, but they had not yet chosen a hall.
listening.zh: 義工選排練場地時，無梯級通道跟費用同屬最重視之列；他們先比這兩項，再考慮舞台燈，但尚未選定禮堂。

reply.promptEn: Why are you checking access before comparing the stage lights?
reply.promptZh: 你們為甚麼先查通道，再比舞台燈？

options.en: Being able to enter and use the venue is a major priority for the volunteers.
options.zh: 能進入及使用場地，是義工的主要考慮。

options.en: Access is right up there with cost in our comparison, so it needs attention early.
options.zh: 在我們的比較中，通道跟費用同屬最重要之列，所以需較早留意。

options.en: The group wants to compare practical entry conditions before the lighting features.
options.zh: 小組想先比實際進出條件，再比燈光設備。

options.en: The venue has to work for the people using it, not only look good on stage.
options.zh: 場地需適合使用者，不只舞台看來好。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均給使用需要及排序理由，不從重要程度推場地已選定。

scene.promptZh: 你寫個人短評，認為一位演員的安靜告別場景，是本季你最難忘的演出之一；沒有頒名次。哪句有適當範圍？

options.en: For me, that quiet farewell is right up there among the season’s most memorable performances.
options.zh: 對我而言，那段安靜告別屬本季最難忘演出之列。

options.en: The scene has officially won first place in the season’s performance awards.
options.zh: 場景已正式贏得本季表演獎第一名。

options.en: The review ranks the scene by technical difficulty rather than by the writer’s personal sense of what was memorable.
options.zh: 短評按技術難度排名，不是按作者個人難忘感受評價。

scene.explanationZh: 題目給個人難忘程度的高評價，不是正式獎項名次或技術難度排名。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 an example is right up there with the best 推出？

options.en: It is being evaluated as belonging among strong examples.
options.zh: 它被評為強例子之列。

options.en: It has definitely received the unique first-place award.
options.zh: 它肯定已獲唯一第一名獎項。

options.en: The comparison should be understood within the speaker’s stated criterion.
options.zh: 應按說話者所列標準理解這個比較。

contrast.explanationZh: 高評價不自動提供正式名次或唯一冠軍。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友想把你稱演出「right up there」的個人短評改成已贏獎；你只說自己難忘。哪句最好？

options.en: Keep it as my evaluation of a memorable performance, rather than turn it into an award result I did not report.
options.zh: 保留它作我對難忘演出的評價，不要改成我未報過的獎項結果。

options.en: So you are reporting an official first-place result rather than a personal comparison.
options.zh: 所以你在報告正式第一名結果，不是作個人比較。

options.en: We should remove my comparison altogether because no official prize was involved.
options.zh: 因沒有正式獎項，應把我的比較全部刪掉。

dialogue.explanationZh: 可保留有限度個人評價，不升格成獎項，也不因未頒獎便不能作比較。

speaking.en: For our group, reliability is right up there with speed when we compare the two services.
speaking.zh: 對我們小組而言，比較兩項服務時，可靠程度跟速度同屬最重視之列。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再說明是誰按甚麼標準作高評價。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你準備團隊合作展覽，組員一直只選畫得最細緻的作品，但你認為一起討論、清楚說明修改理由，也應跟完成作品質素同樣重要。你想在小組訊息提出加入評選標準，不聲稱討論已獲正式評分或一定取代技巧。用一至兩句英文提出。

examples.en: Clear explanations of our revisions should be right up there with the finished artwork when we choose what to display. Could we include the discussion behind each piece in our selection criteria?
examples.zh: 選展品時，清楚解釋修改理由應跟完成作品同屬最重視之列；可否把每件作品背後的討論加入評選標準？

examples.en: For a collaborative exhibition, how we explain our choices belongs right up there with technical detail. Let us consider both when selecting the pieces, rather than judge only the surface finish.
examples.zh: 合作展覽中，我們怎解釋取捨，應跟技術細節同屬最重要之列；選作品時兩者都考慮，不只看表面完成度吧。

writing.selfCheckZh: 提出共同展覽的比較標準並保留技巧，不把「應重視」寫成已評分或已獲獎。

takeaways.en: Her account of the journey is right up there with my favourite chapters because the small details make the setting vivid.
takeaways.zh: 她那段旅程敘述屬我最愛章節之列，因小細節讓環境鮮明。

takeaways.en: For the new tenants, a responsive landlord was right up there with a convenient location when they compared the offers.
takeaways.zh: 新租客比較條件時，肯回應的業主跟方便地點同屬最重視之列。

review.author: AI author source_inventory

english.evidence: Informal high-ranking/priority construction with explicit criterion and no exact rank. Main prioritises practical access; scene offers personal artistic evaluation; final negotiates process criteria for collaborative selection, not another location comparison.

chinese.evidence: Traditional Chinese checked against English subjects, negation, tense and modality; no independent human approval claimed.

lessons.titleZh: 一點也不抽象，切實相關

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: After the storm, the danger felt not abstract at all.

brief.meaningEn: Experienced as concrete or directly relevant, rather than only a general idea or theory.
brief.meaningZh: 被體會為具體或切身相關，而不只是一般概念或理論。
brief.grammar: be/feel/seem not abstract at all; more naturally often X is not abstract at all: + concrete explanation. At all strengthens the negative; the clause should make clear what abstract refers to.
brief.register: Natural emphatic description, not a separate idiom. Concrete experience can illustrate an issue without proving every causal claim about it.
brief.boundaryZh: 不抽象表示有具體連結，不等於已知所有原因、人人同感或理論無用。
brief.misconceptionZh: 應給實際事件、選擇或影響作依據，不只用強調詞代例子。
brief.outcomeZh: 能把一般議題連到可描述的日常經驗，保留證據限制。

listening.promptZh: 甚麼使通達成為具體問題？

options.en: A lift failure prevented two visitors reaching a session and required a room change.
options.zh: 升降機故障令兩位訪客未能到活動，需更換房間。

options.en: The guide was discussing only a proposed building with no visitors or activities yet.
options.zh: 導賞員只在談尚無訪客及活動的擬建大樓。

options.en: The workshop remained upstairs because the lift had already been repaired before the visitors arrived.
options.zh: 訪客到前升降機已修好，所以工作坊仍留樓上。

options.en: The visitors chose another museum after the guide cancelled the whole day’s programme.
options.zh: 導賞員取消全日節目後，訪客選了另一間博物館。

listening.explanationZh: 實際到不了工作坊及改場地，是具體影響；不是只談未建設計，也未說升降機已修或全日取消。
listening.en: For the museum guide, access is not abstract at all: when the lift failed on Saturday, two visitors could not reach the workshop upstairs, so the team moved the session to the entrance room.
listening.zh: 對博物館導賞員而言，通達一點也不抽象；星期六升降機故障，兩位訪客未能到樓上工作坊，所以團隊把活動移到入口房間。

reply.promptEn: Why does access feel like a practical issue to the guide?
reply.promptZh: 通達為甚麼對導賞員是切實問題？

options.en: The broken lift stopped visitors from getting to the upstairs workshop.
options.zh: 壞升降機讓訪客不能到樓上工作坊。

options.en: It is not abstract at all when visitors cannot reach the session and the team has to move it.
options.zh: 訪客到不了活動，團隊需搬場，這一點也不抽象。

options.en: The team had to make an immediate room arrangement, not just discuss a general principle.
options.zh: 團隊需即時安排房間，不只是討論一般原則。

options.en: The problem affected who could take part that Saturday.
options.zh: 問題影響了那個星期六誰能參加。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均以實際參與及改場地說明，不把強調語氣當原因已全查清。

scene.promptZh: 小說讀書會談「信任」，你想用角色答應保管信件卻私自拆看的事件，說明這並非只是一個概念；你仍未知道他拆信的動機。哪句合適？

options.en: Trust is not abstract at all in this scene: opening the letter breaks a specific promise, even though his motive remains unclear.
options.zh: 這場景中，信任一點也不抽象；拆信違反了具體承諾，雖然動機仍不清楚。

options.en: The broken promise explains his full motive without any further scene or dialogue.
options.zh: 違反承諾已解釋他的完整動機，不需其他場景或對話。

options.en: The promise remains hypothetical because no action involving the letter has occurred.
options.zh: 承諾仍是假設，因尚未發生任何涉及信件的行動。

scene.explanationZh: 私自拆看是已發生的具體行動，連到承諾及信任；能指出違反承諾，不代表動機已知，也不是只談假設。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 this issue is not abstract at all 推出？

options.en: The speaker can connect it with concrete experience or consequences.
options.zh: 說話者可把議題連到具體經驗或後果。

options.en: Every explanation of its causes has already been confirmed.
options.zh: 關於成因的每個解釋都已確認。

options.en: The context may show a decision or event that makes the relevance clear.
options.zh: 情境可用決定或事件顯示切實關連。

contrast.explanationZh: 切實相關與成因已確認是不同判斷。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友想因升降機故障的故事切實，就在報告直接寫已證整座樓所有活動都不能使用；你只記到兩人到不了樓上工作坊。哪句最好？

options.en: Access is not abstract at all here, but let us describe the visitors and the room change we recorded rather than expand the claim to every activity.
options.zh: 通達在此一點也不抽象，但按紀錄寫訪客及改場地，不要把主張擴到每項活動吧。

options.en: We can replace the two recorded visitors with a claim about the whole programme without checking other rooms.
options.zh: 不用查其他房間，就可把兩位有紀錄的訪客改成關於全節目的主張。

options.en: Since we have not checked the whole programme, the lift incident should be left out of the report.
options.zh: 既未查全節目，就應從報告刪掉升降機事件。

dialogue.explanationZh: 可保留有紀錄的切實影響，不超出範圍，也不因未涵蓋全樓便刪個案。

speaking.en: The problem is not abstract at all for us: it changes who can join the activity and what arrangements we need to make.
speaking.zh: 對我們而言，問題一點也不抽象；它影響誰能參加活動，以及需作甚麼安排。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再以具體影響解釋切實關連。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你替學校迎新手冊改「尊重別人的時間」一段，不想只留口號。你選一個可實踐例子：小組會議前說清預計多久，臨時延長先問對方是否方便，也容許他按原定時間離開。用一至兩句英文寫手冊文字，不把有禮貌等同大家必須留下。

examples.en: Respect for other people’s time is not abstract at all: state how long the meeting should take and ask before extending it. Someone who needs to leave at the agreed time should be able to do so.
examples.zh: 尊重別人時間一點也不抽象；先說會議預計多久，延長前先問；需按議定時間離開的人，應可照原定安排走。

examples.en: Consideration is not abstract at all when we give a clear finishing time and check whether a longer meeting suits the others. Let people leave as agreed rather than treat staying late as the only sign of commitment.
examples.zh: 說清結束時間，並問延長會議是否方便別人時，體諒一點也不抽象；讓大家按議定時間走，不把留得晚當投入的唯一表現。

writing.selfCheckZh: 用可實行的會議安排說尊重，先詢問並保留原定離開選擇，不要求用額外時間證明態度。

takeaways.en: For the night workers, noise was not abstract at all; it interrupted the sleep they depended on before a shift.
takeaways.zh: 對夜班工人而言，噪音一點也不抽象；它打斷了上班前所需的睡眠。

takeaways.en: Fairness is not abstract at all when the group decides whose work is named in the programme.
takeaways.zh: 小組決定節目表列出誰的工作時，公平一點也不抽象。

sources.sentence: The rumour spread like ink in water.

brief.meaningEn: Spread through a wider group or area in an image resembling ink dispersing through water.
brief.meaningZh: 以墨在水中散開的形象，描述事物傳入更廣群體或範圍。
brief.grammar: the rumour/news/influence spread/spreads/is spreading like ink in water; spread is also past tense. An explicit simile suggests dispersal, not a measured speed, a proven source or inevitable total coverage.
brief.register: Creative explicit simile. Explain what spread and how its movement is observed; the image itself does not verify the content being shared.
brief.boundaryZh: 擴散不證傳言真確，也不自動表示每人已收到或同意；需分傳播範圍及內容查證。
brief.misconceptionZh: 生動比喻可與具體傳播紀錄並用，不以像墨散開就當無法回應或追查。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描寫擴散形態，區分傳開與證實。

listening.promptZh: 甚麼傳開，已知通告其實說甚麼？

options.en: A cancellation rumour reached several classes, while the announcement concerned a room change.
options.zh: 取消活動的傳言傳到幾班，原通告卻關於換房間。

options.en: The organiser confirmed a cancellation before the cropped notice was shared.
options.zh: 截短通告轉發前，主辦人已確認取消。

options.en: The room change stayed within one private conversation and prompted no questions elsewhere.
options.zh: 換房間只留在一段私下談話，其他地方沒有提問。

options.en: All three classes had already moved to the new room before the notice appeared.
options.zh: 通告出現前，三班已移到新房間。

listening.explanationZh: 三班提問是擴散線索，內容卻把換房間誤當取消；比喻不證取消真確。
listening.en: The rumour spread like ink in water after a cropped notice was shared between class groups; by lunch, people in three classes were asking about a cancellation, although the organiser had announced only a room change.
listening.zh: 截短通告在班群間轉發後，傳言像墨入水般散開；午飯時三班已有學生問取消活動，但主辦人只公布更改房間。

reply.promptEn: Why did you describe the rumour as spreading so widely?
reply.promptZh: 你為甚麼說傳言擴散得很廣？

options.en: The cropped notice moved between class groups, and students in three classes asked about it.
options.zh: 截短通告在班群間轉發，三班學生都問了。

options.en: It spread like ink in water as the same cancellation claim appeared in several class groups.
options.zh: 同一取消說法在幾個班群出現，像墨入水般散開。

options.en: The questions came from more than the group where the cropped notice first appeared.
options.zh: 問題不只來自截短通告最先出現的群組。

options.en: The chain of sharing carried one misunderstanding into several classes before lunch.
options.zh: 轉發把同一誤解在午飯前帶到幾班。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均以跨班轉發及提問說傳播，不以人多就當內容已查證。

scene.promptZh: 你寫舞台短評，第一位演員開始輕敲節奏，其他人逐個加入，聲音從舞台一側移向另一側；你想用墨入水形容節奏散開，不說所有觀眾也加入。哪句合適？

options.en: The rhythm spread like ink in water as the performers joined one by one across the stage.
options.zh: 表演者沿舞台逐個加入，節奏像墨入水般散開。

options.en: The rhythm began with all the performers striking together rather than joining one by one.
options.zh: 節奏從演員一起敲開始，不是逐個加入。

options.en: The comparison establishes the exact number of seconds each performer waited before joining.
options.zh: 這個比喻確定每位演員等了幾秒才加入。

scene.explanationZh: 逐個沿台加入支持擴散形象，不是全體同時開始，也未提供確切秒數。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 a rumour spread like ink in water 推出？

options.en: The writer pictures the rumour dispersing into a wider group.
options.zh: 作者把傳言描繪成向更廣群體散開。

options.en: The rumour’s content has been checked and proved true.
options.zh: 傳言內容已核對並證實真確。

options.en: Details of sharing can support the dispersal image.
options.zh: 轉發細節可支持擴散形象。

contrast.explanationZh: 傳開描述流通，查證描述內容可靠程度；兩者不能相代。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴想因三班都問取消，就在更正也寫活動曾取消；原通告只換房。哪句最好？

options.en: The rumour spread like ink in water, but the correction should separate that spread from the original notice and state the confirmed room change.
options.zh: 傳言像墨入水般散開，但更正應分清流傳說法與原通告，寫明已確認的換房安排。

options.en: Let us use the number of groups sharing the rumour as confirmation of the cancellation.
options.zh: 把轉發傳言的群組數當作取消已確認的依據吧。

options.en: We can send the new room number without explaining that the cancellation claim was a misunderstanding.
options.zh: 只發新房號，不用解釋取消說法是誤解。

dialogue.explanationZh: 更正需兼顧誤解及正確安排；轉發數不是取消證據，只發房號也可能讓取消疑問仍留。

speaking.en: The idea spread like ink in water through the discussion groups, but we still need to ask which parts people actually understood.
speaking.zh: 想法像墨入水般在討論群散開，但我們仍需問大家實際理解了哪些部分。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清流傳範圍及實際理解。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你替校刊寫一段社區工藝報道，一位街坊教鄰居補衣，鄰居再把方法教給家人，之後兩個小組開始互換示範。你想用墨入水比喻技能經人際傳授而散開，提議訪問學員各自改了哪些做法，不宣稱全區已學會或每人方法相同。用一至兩句英文寫報道提案。

examples.en: The mending practice spread like ink in water as neighbours taught relatives and then exchanged demonstrations in two groups. We could interview the learners about what they kept and what they adapted.
examples.zh: 街坊教親人，再在兩個小組交換示範，補衣做法像墨入水般散開；我們可訪問學員保留了甚麼，以及改了甚麼。

examples.en: Skills are spreading like ink in water through these family lessons and shared demonstrations. I suggest tracing a few learners’ versions rather than claiming that the whole neighbourhood now uses one method.
examples.zh: 技能正透過家庭教學及共同示範，像墨入水般散開；我提議追訪幾位學員的版本，不聲稱全區現用同一方法。

writing.selfCheckZh: 以有紀錄的人際傳授及兩組交流支持比喻，提出追訪差異；不把流通當全區掌握或完全相同。

takeaways.en: The melody spread like ink in water as each section of the choir picked it up.
takeaways.zh: 合唱團各聲部陸續接上，旋律像墨入水般散開。

takeaways.en: The unverified story was spreading like ink in water through the online groups, so the organiser posted the complete notice.
takeaways.zh: 未核實故事像墨入水般在網上群組散開，所以主辦人貼出完整通告。

sources.sentence: Once the error can get into the system, it may spread.

brief.meaningEn: Enter a connected process, network or organised set of records, where it can be used or passed on.
brief.meaningZh: 進入相連流程、網絡或有組織的紀錄，之後可被使用或傳遞。
brief.grammar: an error/item gets into the system; get/got/getting into. State what system means in context. Entry does not by itself establish approval, accuracy or influence on every output.
brief.register: Reusable get-into entry pattern. The source applies it to an error entering a process; the lesson distinguishes entry from verification rather than teaching unauthorised computer access.
brief.boundaryZh: 進入流程不等於獲批、正確或已影響全部結果；需查進入哪一步及後續用途。
brief.misconceptionZh: 錯誤可在輸入後才被發現，應保留更正及版本線索，不由系統有紀錄便當已核妥。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述輸入、處理與核實的不同階段。

listening.promptZh: 舊資料怎樣進入，在哪一步發現？

options.en: It was copied from an old sheet and found on draft invitations before sending.
options.zh: 舊資料從先前表格抄入，在邀請草稿發現，仍未寄出。

options.en: The new booking was checked first, and the copied room number matched it.
options.zh: 先核了新預約，抄入的房號跟它一致。

options.en: The invitations had already been sent when the team first saw the old room number.
options.zh: 團隊首次看到舊房號時，邀請已寄出。

options.en: The helper entered the current number correctly, and the error arose only at the printing stage.
options.zh: 幫手正確輸入現時房號，錯誤只在印刷階段出現。

listening.explanationZh: 先抄舊表、再入草稿，寄前核新預約才發現；有紀錄不代表資料已核對。
listening.en: The old room number got into the system when a helper copied last term’s booking sheet; it then appeared on the draft invitations, but a check against the new booking caught it before the invitations were sent.
listening.zh: 幫手抄上學期預約表時，舊房號進了系統，之後出現在邀請草稿；但邀請寄出前，團隊用新預約核對，發現了錯誤。

reply.promptEn: Why was the wrong room number on the draft invitations?
reply.promptZh: 邀請草稿為甚麼有錯房號？

options.en: A helper copied it from last term’s booking sheet.
options.zh: 幫手從上學期預約表抄了它。

options.en: It got into the system through an old sheet before anyone compared it with the new booking.
options.zh: 未有人跟新預約比較前，它已透過舊表進了系統。

options.en: The invitation draft used the copied information, which had not yet been checked against the current booking.
options.zh: 邀請草稿用了抄來資料，當時仍未核對現有預約。

options.en: The old value was carried into the draft rather than replaced with the current room number.
options.zh: 舊資料被帶入草稿，沒有換成現時房號。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均指出舊表及核對次序，不把系統輸入說成資料已獲確認。

scene.promptZh: 虛構園藝社把一張植物觀察卡輸入共用資料庫，卡上寫「品種待確認」；系統保留了這標記。哪句準確？

options.en: The observation has got into the system, but its plant identification is still marked as unconfirmed.
options.zh: 觀察資料已進系統，但植物品種仍標示未確認。

options.en: Entry into the database has confirmed the plant identification without another check.
options.zh: 輸入資料庫已確認植物品種，不需再核。

options.en: The observation remains only on paper and has not been entered in the shared records.
options.zh: 觀察仍只在紙上，未輸入共用紀錄。

scene.explanationZh: 進資料庫與品種核實是不同階段；保留待確認標記，沒有自動升格為定論。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 information has got into the system 推出？

options.en: The information has entered the relevant process or records.
options.zh: 資料已進入相關流程或紀錄。

options.en: It has necessarily been checked and approved as accurate.
options.zh: 資料必已核對並獲確認準確。

options.en: The context is needed to know how the information may be used next.
options.zh: 仍需情境才知道資料之後可能怎被使用。

contrast.explanationZh: 進入只描述流程位置，不自動表示核實或批准。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說舊房號能進系統，就一定是現時已核的預約；你找到抄舊表紀錄。哪句最好？

options.en: It got into the system from last term’s sheet; let us check the current booking and update the draft before sending it.
options.zh: 它從上學期表格進了系統；寄出前，先核現時預約並更新草稿吧。

options.en: The stored number is enough, so we can skip comparing it with the new booking.
options.zh: 已存的房號已足夠，所以不用跟新預約比較。

options.en: We should change the number on the draft but leave the copied record unchanged for the next invitation.
options.zh: 只改草稿房號，把抄入紀錄保留原樣供下次邀請使用。

dialogue.explanationZh: 核源頭並改後續使用資料，可避免錯誤再傳；存入不等於已核，只改一份草稿也可能留下重用問題。

speaking.en: Once an error gets into the system, we need to trace where it was used and correct the record as well as the next output.
speaking.zh: 錯誤一旦進系統，就需追查在哪裏被使用，並同時改紀錄及下一份輸出。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清輸入、使用及更正。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你替虛構故事比賽寫投稿指引，收到投稿後會先登記，再由編輯檢查是否齊頁，評審最後才選作品。你想用一至兩句英文提醒作者，收到登記電郵表示稿件進流程，並不等於已入選；若登記資料錯，可回覆更正。

examples.en: The registration email means your story has got into the system, not that it has been selected by the judges. Please reply if the recorded details need correcting while the editors check that all pages are present.
examples.zh: 登記電郵表示故事已進流程，不是已獲評審選中；編輯檢查頁數是否齊全期間，如登記資料有錯，請回覆更正。

examples.en: Once your entry gets into the system, we record it before the completeness check and the later judging stage. You can correct the registration details by replying to the email; selection is still a separate decision.
examples.zh: 投稿進流程後，我們會先登記，之後才查是否齊全，再交評審；可回覆電郵更正登記資料，入選仍是另一項決定。

writing.selfCheckZh: 清楚列登記、齊全檢查及評審次序，提供更正途徑；不把進流程當獲選，也不把待核資料寫成已錯。

takeaways.en: A mistaken delivery date got into the system through a copied order, so the team checked the related notices before sending them.
takeaways.zh: 錯送貨日期透過抄入訂單進了系統，所以團隊在寄通知前先核相關內容。

takeaways.en: The request is getting into the system through the new form, but approval will come from a separate review.
takeaways.zh: 請求正透過新表格進入流程，但批准仍需另一輪審閱。

brief.meaningEn: Eventually suffer an unwanted consequence of an action, decision or situation.
brief.meaningZh: 最終因某項行動、決定或情況承受不良後果。
brief.grammar: end up paying the price for + noun/-ing; end/ends/ended/ending up. Paying the price can be figurative harm or inconvenience, not necessarily a monetary charge.
brief.register: Established consequence idiom. The person bearing the consequence need not be the person who made the earlier decision; explain the actual causal link.
brief.boundaryZh: 承受後果不證本人有錯，也不一定是罰款；若用 may，仍保留可能而非已發生。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要因誰受影響就歸責誰，亦不以生動說法代具體因果資料。
brief.outcomeZh: 能分清決定者、受影響者及實際或可能後果。

listening.promptZh: 誰承受甚麼後果，誰未作先前決定？

options.en: New helpers had to resolve missing names during opening, despite not deciding to delay the check.
options.zh: 新幫手需在開場時處理漏名，卻不是他們決定延後核對。

options.en: The new helpers chose to postpone the check and then charged visitors a higher admission fee.
options.zh: 新幫手選擇延後核對，再向訪客加收門票。

options.en: The missing names were corrected before opening, so the helpers spent the hour guiding visitors normally.
options.zh: 漏名已在開場前更正，所以幫手照常帶訪客。

options.en: The scheduling team completed the check and asked the new helpers only to print the finished list.
options.zh: 排時段的團隊已核完，只請新幫手印好名單。

listening.explanationZh: 後果是開場處理漏名的工作，不是金錢罰款；承受者與先前決定者不同。
listening.en: When the team postponed checking the visitor list, the new helpers ended up paying the price: they spent the opening hour finding missing names at the desk, although they had not made the earlier scheduling decision.
listening.zh: 團隊把核訪客名單押後，新幫手最終承受後果；開場一小時都在登記枱找漏了的名字，雖然先前時段安排不是他們決定。

reply.promptEn: Why did the delay make opening harder for the new helpers?
reply.promptZh: 延遲為甚麼讓新幫手在開場較難應付？

options.en: They had to find the missing names while visitors were arriving.
options.zh: 訪客到場時，他們需找漏名。

options.en: They ended up paying the price for the delayed check by doing the repair work during opening.
options.zh: 核對延後，令他們最終在開場做補救工作，承受後果。

options.en: Work that could have been done earlier fell to them at the busy desk.
options.zh: 原可較早處理的工作，落到忙碌登記枱的他們身上。

options.en: The unfinished list left them resolving problems instead of following the planned welcome routine.
options.zh: 未完成的名單讓他們忙於解問題，不能按原定迎新流程。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均給延後核名單與開場補救的關係，不把受影響當曾決定延遲。

scene.promptZh: 虛構學生刊物準備刪去最後一輪相片核對；編輯擔心若刊錯人名，被誤標的受訪者可能需向朋友解釋，但錯誤尚未發生。哪句保留可能及責任？

options.en: The people in the photographs may end up paying the price if unchecked names are printed incorrectly.
options.zh: 若未核人名被刊錯，相中人可能最終承受後果。

options.en: The caption error has already been printed, and the people in the photographs are now explaining it to their friends.
options.zh: 照片說明錯誤已刊出，相中人正在向朋友解釋。

options.en: The caption check has already prevented the mistake, so no decision about checking remains.
options.zh: 相片說明核對已避免錯誤，所以不用再決定是否核對。

scene.explanationZh: 這是未核便刊錯可能帶來的風險；題目說錯誤尚未發生，也未說核對已避免錯誤。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 someone ended up paying the price 推出？

options.en: They experienced an unwanted consequence.
options.zh: 他們承受了不良後果。

options.en: They necessarily caused the original problem or paid an actual fee.
options.zh: 原問題必由他們造成，或他們必付了實際費用。

options.en: The context should explain the consequence and its connection to earlier events.
options.zh: 情境應解釋後果及它跟先前事件的關係。

contrast.explanationZh: 慣用語可指時間、信任等代價；不自動分配過錯，也不限金錢。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友想因新幫手在補漏名，就在回顧寫他們造成延遲；排時段紀錄卻顯示決定由舊團隊作出。哪句最好？

options.en: They ended up paying the price for the delay, but the scheduling record shows who made that decision; let us describe both accurately.
options.zh: 他們最終承受延遲後果，但時段紀錄顯示誰作決定；把兩者都寫準確吧。

options.en: The people doing the repair can stand in for the earlier decision-makers in the report.
options.zh: 報告可把做補救的人當作先前決定者。

options.en: Since the helpers did not make the decision, we should omit the extra work they faced at opening.
options.zh: 幫手既不是決定者，便應刪去他們開場承受的額外工作。

dialogue.explanationZh: 分清形成與影響，既不錯歸責，也不刪掉實際承受的後果。

speaking.en: Others may end up paying the price for a rushed decision, so we should ask who will face the consequences before we proceed.
speaking.zh: 倉促決定可能讓別人最終承受後果，所以行動前，應問誰會面對影響。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清作決定與承受後果。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你寫角色的反省信，他為提早交出共同劇本，未等朋友要求的最後核稿，便把缺少朋友重要段落的舊版本提交，刊物照那版本刊出；朋友需向合作演員解釋。角色想承認自己的決定讓朋友承受後果，先問刊物更正可能，再跟朋友商量，不保證一定刊更正。用一至兩句英文寫他的話。

examples.en: You ended up paying the price for my decision to submit an old draft before your final check, and I am sorry you had to explain the missing passage. I will ask whether a correction is possible, then discuss the reply with you.
examples.zh: 我未等你最後核稿便提交舊版，最終由你承受後果；要你解釋缺少段落，我很抱歉；我會先問可否更正，再跟你談回覆。

examples.en: I rushed the submission of an old draft, and you ended up paying the price when your passage was missing from the published version. Let me ask about a correction without promising an outcome before we hear back.
examples.zh: 我倉促提交舊版，刊出版本缺少你的段落，最終由你承受後果；讓我先問更正，不在收到回覆前承諾結果。

writing.selfCheckZh: 明說未等核稿便提交缺段舊版、該版被刊出的因果，承認朋友需解釋的影響；詢問更正但不保證結果，也不把責任改成刊物自行刪段。

takeaways.en: The passengers ended up paying the price for the unannounced timetable change when they missed the last connection.
takeaways.zh: 時間表改動沒有通知，乘客錯過最後接駁，最終承受後果。

takeaways.en: If we leave the instructions unclear, tomorrow’s volunteers may end up paying the price in extra work.
takeaways.zh: 若指示仍不清，明天義工可能最終需多做工作來承受後果。

sources.sentence: Tiny pieces of plastic can find their way into rivers.

brief.meaningEn: Reach or enter a place, group or process, often indirectly, unexpectedly or through several stages.
brief.meaningZh: 往往經間接、意外或幾個步驟，到達或進入某處、群體或流程。
brief.grammar: something finds its way into + destination; plural things find their way into; found/finding. Inanimate things need no conscious intention. The context, not the phrase alone, supplies the route or speed.
brief.register: Conventional movement expression used literally or figuratively. It differs from someone deliberately finding a route, though both share the movement image.
brief.boundaryZh: 到達不自證經哪條路、是否故意或用了多久；需有紀錄才說具體途徑。
brief.misconceptionZh: 可追溯傳遞階段，不由物件進入就推有人刻意放入或整份內容相同。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述間接進入，分清結果、推測途徑與已核實過程。

listening.promptZh: 句子怎樣進入節目單，後來做甚麼？

options.en: Reusing the draft carried the sentence into a proof, where it was removed before printing.
options.zh: 重用草稿把句子帶進校樣，之後在印前刪掉。

options.en: The sentence was deliberately added to the printed copies after the proof had been checked.
options.zh: 校樣核後，有人刻意把句子加進已印副本。

options.en: The private notes never appeared in any version of the programme.
options.zh: 私人筆記從未出現在任何版本的節目單。

options.en: The printed programme had already been distributed before the sentence was noticed.
options.zh: 發現句子前，已印節目單已派出。

listening.explanationZh: 重用檔案是已有途徑，校樣階段發現並刪；不是已派出，也未說刻意放入。
listening.en: A sentence from my private planning notes found its way into the public programme when we reused the draft file; I noticed it in the proof and removed it before printing, then checked which file the team would use next.
listening.zh: 我們重用草稿檔時，私人規劃筆記的一句話進了公開節目單；我在校樣發現，印前刪掉，再核團隊之後會用哪個檔。

reply.promptEn: Why did you check which file the team would use next?
reply.promptZh: 你為甚麼查團隊之後會用哪個檔？

options.en: The unwanted sentence had come from a reused draft.
options.zh: 不想公開的句子來自重用草稿。

options.en: A private note had found its way into the programme, so I wanted to stop the same draft being reused unchanged.
options.zh: 私人筆記一句話已進節目單，所以我想避免同一草稿未改便再用。

options.en: Removing the sentence from one proof would not necessarily change the file used for the next version.
options.zh: 刪一份校樣的句子，不一定會改之後版本所用的檔。

options.en: We needed to know whether the corrected version would replace the old draft.
options.zh: 我們需知道更正版會否取代舊草稿。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均連到重用草稿及下一版本，不把校樣刪字當所有源檔已改。

scene.promptZh: 你追查地方食譜，一份家庭手寫做法先交給鄰居，後被收進社區小冊；紀錄沒有說原作者主動投稿。哪句準確？

options.en: The handwritten recipe found its way into the community booklet after being shared with a neighbour.
options.zh: 手寫食譜與鄰居分享後，進了社區小冊。

options.en: The original author personally submitted the recipe to the booklet’s editor.
options.zh: 原作者親自向小冊編輯投稿食譜。

options.en: The booklet was the first place the recipe existed, before any family copy was written.
options.zh: 家庭副本寫出前，食譜最先存在於小冊。

scene.explanationZh: 已有家庭到鄰居再到小冊的途徑，未支持原作者親投或小冊最先創作。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 material found its way into a publication 推出？

options.en: The material reached the publication.
options.zh: 材料進入了刊物。

options.en: The original creator personally and deliberately submitted it.
options.zh: 原創者必定親自並刻意投稿。

options.en: The surrounding account may explain an indirect route.
options.zh: 上下文可能解釋間接途徑。

contrast.explanationZh: 慣用說法不必有原創者主動行為；需靠其他資料判途徑及意圖。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友想因句子進公開節目單，就說你已決定公開整份筆記；紀錄只有重用草稿及校樣刪句。哪句最好？

options.en: One sentence found its way into the proof through a reused draft; that does not show a decision to publish the whole set of notes.
options.zh: 一句話經重用草稿進校樣，不表示已決定公開整份筆記。

options.en: We can treat the copied sentence as permission to publish the remaining notes without asking.
options.zh: 可以把抄入句子當作准許，不用問便公開餘下筆記。

options.en: Because the sentence was removed, there is no reason to record which draft carried it into the proof.
options.zh: 句子既已刪，就沒理由記哪份草稿把它帶進校樣。

dialogue.explanationZh: 按已知句子及途徑說，不擴成整份公開授權；保留來源也有助避免重用舊版。

speaking.en: The old wording found its way into a new handout through a copied file, so we checked the source before correcting the next version.
speaking.zh: 舊字句透過抄檔進了新講義，所以改下一版前，我們先核來源。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再把進入結果及可追查途徑連起來。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你寫文學評論，發現作者童年聽祖母講的渡河故事，經多年改寫，成了小說中孩子獨自過橋的一幕；訪問只確認了影響，沒有說兩段情節相同。用一至兩句英文連起口述故事與小說，並指出改寫差異，不把小說當作者童年的真實紀錄。

examples.en: Her grandmother’s river story found its way into the novel as a child’s solitary bridge crossing. The interview confirms an influence, but the changed scene is not a record of the author’s own childhood journey.
examples.zh: 祖母的渡河故事進了小說，變成孩子獨自過橋的一幕；訪問確認有影響，但改寫場景不是作者童年旅程的紀錄。

examples.en: An element of the old family story found its way into the bridge scene after years of rewriting. We can trace that connection without treating the fictional child’s actions as events from the author’s life.
examples.zh: 多年改寫後，舊家庭故事的一項元素進了過橋場景；可追溯這連結，不把虛構孩子的行動當作者人生事件。

writing.selfCheckZh: 以訪問可確認的影響說進入作品，保留渡河到過橋的改寫，不把小說事件等同作者人生。

takeaways.en: Fragments of the conversation found their way into her later poems, with the names and setting changed.
takeaways.zh: 談話片段進了她後來的詩，名字及場景則已改動。

takeaways.en: The old timetable is finding its way into new messages because people keep copying the same template.
takeaways.zh: 人們不斷抄同一範本，令舊時間表正進入新訊息。

sources.sentence: The reservoir filled drop by drop during the light rain.

brief.meaningEn: In very small amounts added one at a time, literally as drops or figuratively as gradual increments.
brief.meaningZh: 以極小份量逐次增加；可指實際液滴，也可比喻逐點累積。
brief.grammar: drop by drop modifies a filling, adding or gradual-building process. The repeated-noun construction emphasises increments; it does not give a measured rate or guarantee that a final target will be reached.
brief.register: Conventional repeated phrase with literal and figurative uses. Keep the physical image distinct from a claim about the exact quantity of non-liquid things.
brief.boundaryZh: 逐點不等於完全沒進展或必達終點，也不直接提供確切速度及總量。
brief.misconceptionZh: 如用於信任或知識，需說具體小改變，不能把感受當可按液滴精確量度。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用小量累積描寫進展，保留完成程度及比喻限制。

listening.promptZh: 逐滴過程與所作安排是甚麼？

options.en: Water accumulated slowly, and the team changed the container while the leak continued.
options.zh: 水慢慢累積，漏水仍持續，團隊換了容器。

options.en: The bowl filled all at once when someone deliberately emptied a bucket into it.
options.zh: 有人刻意倒入一桶水，令碗一下子滿了。

options.en: The level stayed unchanged because the tap had already been repaired.
options.zh: 水龍頭已修好，所以水位不變。

options.en: The caretaker had already inspected the tap and said the drops were only water left in the pipe.
options.zh: 管理員已查水龍頭，說液滴只是管內剩水。

listening.explanationZh: 實際一滴滴累積，標記及大容器是暫時觀察安排，不等於已修水龍頭。
listening.en: The bowl filled drop by drop from the leaking tap while we waited for the caretaker; the level was rising slowly, so we marked it and moved a larger container underneath without claiming the leak had stopped.
listening.zh: 等管理員時，漏水龍頭一滴一滴注進碗裏；水位慢慢升，所以我們做標記並換大容器接着，沒有說漏水已止。

reply.promptEn: Why did you mark the water level and use a larger container?
reply.promptZh: 你們為甚麼標水位並用大容器？

options.en: The leaking tap was still adding water slowly.
options.zh: 漏水龍頭仍慢慢添水。

options.en: The bowl was filling drop by drop, so we wanted to watch the increase and give the water more room.
options.zh: 碗一滴一滴添水，所以我們想觀察增加，並給水更多容量。

options.en: The level was rising even though the caretaker had not yet repaired the tap.
options.zh: 管理員仍未修水龍頭，水位卻在升。

options.en: We needed a temporary way to collect and observe the water while waiting for the repair.
options.zh: 等維修期間，我們需暫時收集及觀察水。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均連到持續小量添水及暫時接水，不把量水位當修復完成。

scene.promptZh: 故事中角色每周準時還一件借物、主動交代延誤，幾個月後朋友說較願再借；敘述者想用逐滴形象寫信任慢慢恢復。哪句合適？

options.en: Trust returned drop by drop through the small promises she kept over several months.
options.zh: 幾個月內，她守住小承諾，信任逐點恢復。

options.en: One promise instantly restored the friendship to its earlier state before anyone saw her follow through.
options.zh: 未有人見她實踐，一個承諾已即時把友誼恢復原狀。

options.en: The phrase tells us the exact quantity of trust added each week.
options.zh: 這個說法告訴我們每周增加信任的確切數量。

scene.explanationZh: 小行動經月累積支持比喻，不是一次說話就完全修復，也不能按液滴量信任。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 progress comes drop by drop 推出？

options.en: The progress is pictured as small gradual additions.
options.zh: 進展被描寫為逐次小量增加。

options.en: The final goal is guaranteed to be reached on a known date.
options.zh: 最後目標保證在已知日期達成。

options.en: Concrete small changes may help explain the metaphor.
options.zh: 具體小改變可幫解釋比喻。

contrast.explanationZh: 逐點描述過程，不承諾終點或完成日。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說水流很少就可收起碗，但標記顯示水位仍在升，管理員尚未到。哪句最好？

options.en: It is still filling drop by drop; let us keep the container in place and report the rising level rather than assume the leak has ended.
options.zh: 它仍一滴一滴添水；保留接水容器，報告水位上升，不要以為漏水已完吧。

options.en: We can remove the container because a slow leak adds too little water to change the level.
options.zh: 慢漏加水太少，不會改水位，所以可移走容器。

options.en: Let us wait until the larger container is full before asking whether the tap still needs repairing.
options.zh: 等大容器滿了，才問水龍頭是否仍需修吧。

dialogue.explanationZh: 慢不等於無累積，暫時接水亦非修好；按標記及實際漏水說。

speaking.en: Understanding grew drop by drop as I compared each new example with the notes I had already made.
speaking.zh: 我把每個新例子與已有筆記比較，理解逐點增加。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再把小步累積連到具體學習行動。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你替一個口述歷史展寫策展短文，記錄不是一次完整訪問得來，而是幾年內不同居民各提供一段記憶；有些日期仍不一致。你想用逐滴形象說材料慢慢累積，保留不同聲音與待核日期，不把零散拼在一起便當唯一完整真相。用一至兩句英文寫展板文字。

examples.en: This collection grew drop by drop as residents added short memories over several years. We present their different voices together while marking the dates that still need checking.
examples.zh: 居民幾年間逐次提供短記憶，這批材料逐點增加；我們並列不同聲音，同時標明仍需核對的日期。

examples.en: The account came together drop by drop, through many small contributions rather than one complete interview. Differences in the dates remain visible so that the collection does not pretend to be a single settled record.
examples.zh: 敘述經許多小量提供而逐點拼成，不是來自一次完整訪問；日期差異仍清楚可見，不把材料說成唯一已定紀錄。

glossary.en: the dates that still need checking

writing.selfCheckZh: 以多年少量提供說累積，並列聲音及待核日期；不以收得多就當所有版本已一致或資料已完整。

takeaways.en: The fund grew drop by drop through small voluntary donations, but the group had not yet reached its target.
takeaways.zh: 小額自願捐款讓款項逐點增加，但小組仍未達目標。

takeaways.en: Her confidence returned drop by drop as she completed short practice sessions at a pace she chose.
takeaways.zh: 她按自選步調完成短練習，信心逐點恢復。

lessons.titleZh: 由人類活動造成或製作的

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: The lake's pollution is largely man-made.

brief.meaningEn: Made by people or caused by human activity, rather than occurring through natural processes alone.
brief.meaningZh: 由人製作或人類活動造成，而非只由自然過程出現。
brief.grammar: man-made + noun; something is man-made. A hyphen joins the adjective. Human-made is a common alternative. The adjective classifies origin; it does not itself say good, bad, safe or unsafe.
brief.register: Standard compound adjective, not an idiom. It includes activities by people generally, not only males; explain which human action is supported by the evidence.
brief.boundaryZh: 人造或人為不等於必有害、蓄意破壞或某個人已被證有錯；來源分類與價值及責任不同。
brief.misconceptionZh: 可有自然及人為因素並存，不因有自然因素便否認已知人為部分，也不以類別代具體證據。
brief.outcomeZh: 能根據製作或成因資料描述人為來源，分清影響及責任。

listening.promptZh: 池塘與蘆葦的來源有何不同？

options.en: People dug the pond, while the reeds grew naturally at its edges.
options.zh: 池塘由人挖成，蘆葦則在邊緣自然生長。

options.en: Both the pond and the reeds were installed by the residents on the same day.
options.zh: 池塘及蘆葦都是居民同日設置的。

options.en: The plans describe a natural pond that existed before the residents arrived.
options.zh: 圖則描述居民到前已存在的天然池塘。

options.en: The rainwater proves that no human work was involved in creating the pond.
options.zh: 雨水證明造池過程沒有人力參與。

listening.explanationZh: 收集自然雨水的池仍可由人挖造；蘆葦來源另看，不把場地所有東西歸同一類。
listening.en: The pond was man-made: old plans showed that residents had dug it to collect rainwater, while the reeds had grown naturally along its edges; the class kept those two origins separate in the display.
listening.zh: 池塘是人造的；舊圖則顯示居民挖它來收雨水，蘆葦卻在邊緣自然生長；學生在展示中分清兩種來源。

reply.promptEn: Why does the display call the pond man-made?
reply.promptZh: 展示為甚麼說池塘是人造的？

options.en: The old plans show that residents dug it to collect rainwater.
options.zh: 舊圖則顯示居民挖它來收雨水。

options.en: It is man-made because its shape was created by people, even though it holds rainwater.
options.zh: 形狀由人造，即使收的是雨水，它仍是人造池塘。

options.en: Its origin includes a documented digging project, not only a natural hollow filling with water.
options.zh: 來源有挖造工程的紀錄，不只是天然低窪積水。

options.en: The plans provide evidence of the human work that formed the pond.
options.zh: 圖則為形成池塘的人力工作提供證據。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均以挖造紀錄作來源證據，不把雨水來源當池形來源。

scene.promptZh: 科學模型旁有一段仿岩石橋面，製作紀錄說用混合材料倒模，表面再刻紋；外觀像天然石，但未測耐用程度。哪句準確？

options.en: The bridge surface is man-made, although its appearance resembles natural stone.
options.zh: 橋面是人造的，雖然外觀像天然石。

options.en: The natural-looking pattern proves the surface was cut directly from an untouched cliff.
options.zh: 看似天然的紋理證明橋面直接從未經改動的岩壁切出。

options.en: Calling it man-made confirms how long the surface will last outdoors.
options.zh: 稱它人造，已確認它在戶外能維持多久。

scene.explanationZh: 倒模及刻紋有製作紀錄；外觀不改來源分類，來源也不自證耐用。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜只憑 man-made 這個形容詞推出？

options.en: People made the object or contributed the stated cause.
options.zh: 物件由人製作，或所述成因有人類活動參與。

options.en: The thing must be harmful and deliberately designed to cause damage.
options.zh: 該事物必有害，而且被刻意設計來破壞。

options.en: The context is needed to assess effects and responsibility.
options.zh: 評估影響及責任仍需其他情境資料。

contrast.explanationZh: 來源分類不自動判傷害、意圖或責任；可描述有用池塘或人為污染等不同情況。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友想因池塘是人造，就在展示說蘆葦也一定由居民栽種；紀錄說蘆葦自然長出。哪句最好？

options.en: Keep the man-made pond and the naturally grown reeds separate; the evidence gives them different origins.
options.zh: 把人造池塘及自然生長蘆葦分開寫，證據給它們不同來源。

options.en: Let us classify every part of the site by the pond’s origin instead of checking the plant record.
options.zh: 不用看植物紀錄，整個地方都按池塘來源分類吧。

options.en: Because the reeds grew naturally, we should remove the digging plans from the display.
options.zh: 蘆葦自然長出，所以應從展示刪掉挖造圖則。

dialogue.explanationZh: 人為與自然因素可並存；按各項證據分清，不以一項覆蓋其餘或刪相反類別資料。

speaking.en: The lake is man-made, but we need separate evidence before judging its effects on the plants and people around it.
speaking.zh: 湖是人造的，但評估對周圍植物及人的影響前，仍需另有證據。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再把來源分類與影響評估分開。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你為虛構舞台展寫物料說明，雪山場景用可重用紙板及燈光製作，不是真雪或開採的石塊。你想坦白說人造場景的構成及重用計劃，但未計算製作運輸等總影響，不能寫已證環境零負擔。用一至兩句英文寫說明。

examples.en: This man-made mountain uses reusable cardboard and light rather than snow or quarried stone. We plan to use the panels again, but have not measured the production’s full environmental impact.
examples.zh: 這座人造山用可重用紙板及燈光，不是真雪或開採石塊；我們計劃再用板件，但未量製作的整體環境影響。

examples.en: The scenery is man-made, built from cardboard panels that can return in a later show. Reuse is part of our plan, not proof that making and transporting the set had no impact.
examples.zh: 場景是人造的，用可在之後演出再用的紙板件製作；重用是計劃一部分，不是製作及運輸完全沒有影響的證明。

writing.selfCheckZh: 誠實說明人造物料及可重用計劃，保留未測整體影響；不以人造自判好壞，也不把重用說成零影響已證。

takeaways.en: The village walk crosses a man-made channel built to guide water away from the old road.
takeaways.zh: 村內步道跨過一條人造水道，水道原為把水引離舊路而建。

takeaways.en: The report distinguished natural weathering from man-made marks left during the wall’s reconstruction.
takeaways.zh: 報告把自然風化與重建牆壁留下的人為痕跡分開。
